slides.text: When did you stop keeping promises to [[yourself]]?
Every ignored alarm teaches you your word is [[cheap]].
Nobody is checking. That is the [[test]].
Everything you want is [[paid]] for in kept promises.
Trust is rebuilt one small [[link]] at a time.
Keep it when you are tired. Especially [[then]].
Make one promise today. [[Save]] this and come back in thirty days.
